about_the_game:
Balance the Lands

This is a weight balancing game where the lands turn as you apply more weight to either side of the land. You can balance the weight by placing dumbells or blobs on the opposite end that is turning to balance it out. If the land turns too much the land turns red and your blobs on that land won't be able to pickup the jewels and coins. If the land turns too much it's gameover.

Challenge

The challenge of the game is to keep many lands in balance so that you can collect as much coins and jewels as possible. This gets more challenging as you have more lands, blobs and weights on the land.

Interact

The blobs move around collecting coins and jewels, you can also drag them around to collect coins and jewels and help rebalance the land. You can drag the weights around to change the weight where you like also.
